title: verbascum faurei subsp. commixtum
intro: Verbascum faurei subsp. commixtum, commonly known as Mule's Ear or Mullein, is a biennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing respiratory issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum faurei subsp. commixtum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which also make it useful for treating skin conditions and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in the plant's leaves, flowers, and roots.
